Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1,
to be performed every three months as indicated by M3 in the title block.
The first draft is initiated by eng. Ahmed EL-Okaby, tested by 
eng. Tarek EL-kafafy, accepted by general director eng. Nady Mosaed, approved by 
eng. Mohamed EL-Tahawy Head sector of Shoubra EL-Kheima PS.
This document revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha, CEPC quality control director, and certified by 
eng. Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib,
CEPC inspection & quality control 's head sector and MPIS coordinator
Safety Precautions
A
 work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category
Wear your safety helmet & safety shoes
Safety
 fence like ropes with caution marks surrounding the work area
The
 charger must be isolated
Tools and Equipment
Electrical
 tool box
Avometer
An
 industrial vacuum cleaner.
Work to be Carried Out
Check the output voltage in the float position, 
should be 130 V
Check the input voltage, should be 
400 V
Switch off input and output 
breakers
Replace air filters
Clean the battery charger from 
dust
Check and clean the cooler fan
Check the pilot lights
Look for loose wire connection
Switch on input and output 
breakers
Check battery charger for normal
